mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the lunar hypothesis was most worthwhile: comparing a prediction with a record made the distinction between supporting an explanation and proving it clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The opening step produced Wonder without explaining its role, so the route from looking at stars to investigating them initially felt vague.

surprise.text: The tested finding became a shared discovery that others could check and question, extending the inquiry beyond its original observer.

arbitrary.text: Pairing a prediction with memory to create a test made sense in retrospect, but it was unclear beforehand what observations the memory contained.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how shared discoveries develop, especially after the chapter connected questioning with evidence and communication.
